standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145048Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after two fixes. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. tools/check.py --all passes for this issue. Two corrections are recorded here because they changed the computed set. First, the six AMS report 3649 weighted averages were stored under period 2026-10 from a report covering 8/31/2026 to 10/2/2026, which is the September reporting month; the parser took the month from the block's end date. It now takes the month holding most of the block's days, the retained captures were re-parsed, and the readings are present under 2026-09 with period_start and period_end recorded. The 2026-10 rows are not edited or removed; each carries a SUPERSEDED entry in data/flags.jsonl. Second, issue.py built its series map from the named run alone, so this source, which states one period per issue, could never carry any comparison. It is now declared accumulates in sources.json, so the month-over-month comparison the record holds is available: against the prior reporting month, whole wings -9.8% and tenderloins -4.8%, both 2026-09 against 2026-08. Remaining gaps: the wholesale series still carries no year-over-year figure, because the record's earliest reading for it is 2026-08 and no 2025 reading exists; it will carry one when the record holds twelve months. The daily broiler market glance is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. The September baseline has not been recomputed. Publication gated by FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by FA-D-20260923-02 and FA-D-20260923-04.
